game_text_lines:
Heroic. Power and forfeit +1 on Coruscant (+2
if also at same site as a Jedi or leader). While {ovs}
They Will Be Lost And Confused on table,
Palpatine is immune to attrition and your Force
drains at this Clone Trooper’s site are +1.
base_lore: When Vader turned his attention to the escaping Rebels, Han immediately offered Luke some sage advice.

notes: Group: Rescue The Chancellor. COMBO / FULL-CARD OVERLAY (756×1101) that turns a LOST INTERRUPT into a CHARACTER: silver Light character frame (red Interrupt paint showing at the right edge); ROUND silver Republic crest → 'Republic' (printed: red Interrupt disc); title 'Clone Trooper' (no dot); destiny 3 (printed 4). LORE BOX PRINTED EMPTY → lore '' (printed lore in base_lore). Right of the lore box: the A New Hope ring (as printed) and below it a black EPISODE I disc (added) → ring_icons ['episode1']. Art blank. Stats POWER 2 / ABILITY 2 / ARMOR 4, deploy 2 / forfeit 3 (all new); column: warrior; VS16 sphere. Inline blue sphere before 'They Will Be Lost And Confused' = the VS16 set sphere ({ovs}, matched against ovs-set-16.png; that objective is this set's #11). Curly ’ in Trooper’s. Slip text matches the stub. NOTE: the PC's VB5 reissue (modern file) prints DIFFERENT, later text ('While with Palpatine, Heroic… ABILITY 1… attrition < 6 … at same site are +1') and number 38E — art only. Base lore matches the wiki and the scan. ART: ANH-L-blastthedoorkid.gif is 745 px but tagged D-E1 (PC errata face) — used for art only; the printed face is the 350 px ANH-L-blastthedoorkid-decipher-archive.gif (also downloaded to src/vs16/). Copyright 1996 legible on the 745 face. Modern: VB5-L-clonetrooper-pre.gif (350).
